summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a cost increase for Stage 2 of the Jansen potash project. The total investment estimate rose from US$4.9B to US$6.9B, with first production now expected in late FY2031. BHP expects to recognize an impairment charge of approximately US$2.3B on the Jansen asset base. Board recommendation and advisor are not named. This is an operational update on a capital project and does not involve a transaction or special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
